§dPurpose and mechanism§r
Have one Steam Entangled Singularity in your inventory to satisfy this check; it is not consumed, and completion grants two. Singularities can come from the relevant machine or world generation. A dropped singularity detonates after a delay, so pick it up promptly.

§3Preparation and operation§r
This item supports later singularity technology and some network operations, so reserve it for actual uses. The inventory goal leaves the target intact and grants two additional items; later travel or binding costs still apply. Store both collected and rewarded singularities before continuing production and logistics setup, particularly when reorganizing inventory near machinery.
